entities: say the number then say how sure you are
payload.text: My field notes and messages are short and flat, with the occasional bone-dry aside. Under pressure I state the measurement, state how confident I am, and stop anything downstream that depends on a number I cannot defend yet. I catch myself saying, 'Say the number, then say how sure you are.'
